slides.title: Typography & Colors Overview
slides.content:
# Typography & Colors in Tailwind CSS ✍️🎨

Typography and color palettes form the emotional backbone of modern user interfaces. Tailwind CSS ships with an expertly calibrated design system right out of the box.

## What You'll Learn:
- **Font Families**: `font-sans`, `font-serif`, `font-mono`
- **Type Scale**: Sizing from `text-xs` up to `text-9xl`
- **Font Weights**: `font-thin` (100) to `font-black` (900)
- **Vertical Rhythm & Tracking**: `leading-*` (line-height) and `tracking-*` (letter-spacing)
- **Text Alignment & Formatting**: `text-left`, `uppercase`, `truncate`
- **Tailwind Color Palette**: Shades 50 through 950
- **Color Opacity Modifiers**: `text-blue-500/75` syntax

slides.title: Font Families in Tailwind
The Text Sizing Scale
slides.content:
# The Type Scale: Sizing Text 📐

Tailwind pairs font sizes with proportional default line-heights to maintain harmonious vertical rhythm.

## Sizing Scale Reference

| Class | Font Size | Default Line Height | Pixels (base 16px) |
|---|---|---|---|
| `text-xs` | `0.75rem` | `1rem` | 12px / 16px |
| `text-sm` | `0.875rem` | `1.25rem` | 14px / 20px |
| `text-base`| `1rem` | `1.5rem` | 16px / 24px |
| `text-lg` | `1.125rem` | `1.75rem` | 18px / 28px |
| `text-xl` | `1.25rem` | `1.75rem` | 20px / 28px |
| `text-2xl`| `1.5rem` | `2rem` | 24px / 32px |
| `text-3xl`| `1.875rem` | `2.25rem` | 30px / 36px |
| `text-4xl`| `2.25rem` | `2.5rem` | 36px / 40px |
| `text-6xl`| `3.75rem` | `1` | 60px / 60px |

> 💡 **Key Insight:** `text-sm` automatically pairs with `leading-5`, so you don't have to manually set line-height unless desired!

slides.title: Font Weights & Styles
slides.content:
# Font Weights & Italic Styles 🏋️

Control visual emphasis using Tailwind's 9 font weight utilities.

## Font Weights

| Class | CSS Value | Numeric Weight |
|---|---|---|
| `font-thin` | `100` | Thin / Hairline |
| `font-light` | `300` | Light |
| `font-normal`| `400` | Regular (default) |
| `font-medium`| `500` | Medium |
| `font-semibold`| `600` | Semi-Bold |
| `font-bold`  | `700` | Bold |
| `font-extrabold` | `800` | Extra Bold |
| `font-black` | `900` | Black / Heavy |

## Font Styles
- `italic` (`font-style: italic;`)
- `not-italic` (`font-style: normal;`)

slides.title: Line Height & Letter Spacing
slides.content:
# Line Height (Leading) & Tracking 📏

Tailwind decouples line height and letter spacing using `leading-*` and `tracking-*`.

## Line Height (`leading-*`)

- `leading-none` — `line-height: 1;` (great for massive display titles)
- `leading-tight` — `line-height: 1.25;` (ideal for headings)
- `leading-snug` — `line-height: 1.375;`
- `leading-normal` — `line-height: 1.5;` (body text standard)
- `leading-relaxed` — `line-height: 1.625;` (spacious blog reading)
- `leading-loose` — `line-height: 2;`

## Letter Spacing (`tracking-*`)

- `tracking-tighter` (`-0.05em`), `tracking-tight` (`-0.025em`) — Tighter headline tracking
- `tracking-normal` (`0em`)
- `tracking-wide` (`0.025em`), `tracking-wider` (`0.05em`), `tracking-widest` (`0.1em`) — Elegant uppercase badges

slides.title: Text Truncation & Line Clamping
slides.content:
# Text Truncation & Line Clamping ✂️ Dealing with dynamic user text that might overflow its card boundary. ## Single-Line Truncation with `truncate` `truncate` applies `overflow: hidden; text-overflow: ellipsis; white-space: nowrap;`: ```html_not

This very long username will cut off with an ellipsis...

``` ## Multi-Line Clamping with `line-clamp-{n}` Limit text to a specific number of lines before truncating with an ellipsis: ```html_not

This article preview description will render exactly two lines of text on all devices and gracefully append an ellipsis at the end of line two.

```

slides.title: The Tailwind Color Palette
slides.content:
# The Curated Color Palette 🎨

Tailwind includes 22 color families, each calibrated from 50 (lightest tint) to 950 (deepest dark shade).

## Core Color Families

- **Neutrals**: `slate`, `gray`, `zinc`, `neutral`, `stone`
- **Vibrant Primaries**: `red`, `orange`, `amber`, `yellow`, `lime`
- **Cool Hues**: `green`, `emerald`, `teal`, `cyan`, `sky`, `blue`
- **Accents**: `indigo`, `violet`, `purple`, `fuchsia`, `pink`, `rose`

## Shade Ladder Structure

```
50   - Faint card backgrounds, hovered table rows
100  - Badge backgrounds, alert box backgrounds
200  - Subtle border outlines
500  - Primary brand color, toggle switches, icons
600  - Standard button background, active tabs
700  - Button hover state
900  - High-contrast body text
950  - Ultra-dark backgrounds in dark mode
```

slides.title: Color Utilities: Text, Background & Border
slides.content:
# Applying Colors Across CSS Properties 🖌️ The same color family and shade scale applies across all color-related utilities: ## Utility Prefix Mapping | Prefix | CSS Property | Example | |---|---|---| | `text-*` | `color` | `text-slate-900`, `text-indigo-600` | | `bg-*` | `background-color` | `bg-white`, `bg-emerald-500` | | `border-*` | `border-color` | `border-gray-200`, `border-red-500` | | `ring-*` | `outline box-shadow` | `ring-blue-400` | | `accent-*` | `accent-color` (checkboxes) | `accent-indigo-600` | | `caret-*` | `caret-color` (text cursor) | `caret-pink-500` | ```html_not
Harmonious monochromatic styling in 3 simple classes!
```

slides.title: Color Opacity Modifiers
slides.content:
# Alpha Channel & Color Opacity Modifiers 💧 Rather than defining separate semi-transparent colors, Tailwind lets you append an opacity percentage using a slash `/` syntax. ## The Slash `/` Opacity Syntax ```html_not

Subtle Semi-Transparent Border

80% opacity text color

``` ## Arbitrary Opacities You can even use arbitrary opacity values: `bg-indigo-600/[0.12]`!

slides.title: Gradient Backgrounds
slides.content:
# Linear Gradients Made Easy 🌈 Create multi-stop gradients without writing complex `linear-gradient()` CSS. ## Gradient Utilities - Direction: `bg-gradient-to-r` (right), `bg-gradient-to-br` (bottom-right), `bg-gradient-to-t` (top) - Starting Color: `from-{color}-{shade}` - Middle Stop (optional): `via-{color}-{shade}` - Ending Color: `to-{color}-{shade}` ```html_not

Vibrant Gradients

Smooth multi-color transitions with zero custom CSS.

```

slides.title: Gradient Text Effect
slides.content:
# Gradient Text with Background Clip 🌟 Apply rich multi-color gradients directly to typography: ```html_not

Build products 10x faster

``` ## How It Works: 1. `bg-gradient-to-r ...` generates the linear color spectrum. 2. `bg-clip-text` sets `background-clip: text;` clipping the background to the glyph shapes. 3. `text-transparent` sets `color: transparent;` so the background gradient shows through the letters.

slides.title: The @tailwindcss/typography Plugin
slides.content:
# The Official Typography Plugin (`prose`) 📰 When rendering HTML from Markdown, CMS blogs, or comments, individual elements lack Tailwind classes. ## Enter the `prose` Class ```bash_not npm install -D @tailwindcss/typography ``` ```javascript_not // tailwind.config.js module.exports = { plugins: [require('@tailwindcss/typography')], }; ``` ```html_not

HTML from CMS or Markdown

All nested headings, lists, quotes, and tables are styled automatically!

``` > ⚡ **Instant Beauty:** One class gives you typographic hierarchy, responsive sizes (`prose-lg`), and dark mode (`prose-invert`).

slides.title: Accessibility & Color Contrast
slides.content:
# Accessibility & Color Contrast (WCAG) ♿

Always ensure text has sufficient contrast against its background:

## WCAG 2.1 Contrast Standards

- **Normal Text**: Minimum contrast ratio of **4.5:1** (AA standard)
- **Large Text (18px+ bold or 24px+)**: Minimum contrast ratio of **3:1**

## Tailwind Contrast Best Practices

| Background | Accessible Text Class | Non-Accessible (Avoid) |
|---|---|---|
| `bg-white` | `text-slate-800`, `text-slate-900` | `text-slate-300`, `text-gray-400` |
| `bg-slate-900` | `text-white`, `text-slate-100` | `text-slate-600`, `text-slate-700` |
| `bg-indigo-600` | `text-white` | `text-indigo-300` |

> 🎯 **Tip:** Use light shades (50-100) or dark shades (800-950) for text to comfortably pass WCAG audits.

slides.title: Summary: Typography & Colors
slides.content:
# Typography & Colors: Summary 📋

## Quick Review
- **Font Families**: Set default stacks with `font-sans`, `font-serif`, `font-mono`.
- **Type Hierarchy**: Combine `text-*`, `font-*`, `leading-*`, and `tracking-*`.
- **Truncation**: Use `truncate` for 1 line or `line-clamp-{n}` for multi-line clamping.
- **Color System**: Leverage 22 calibrated color families from 50 to 950.
- **Opacity**: Use modern `/` notation (e.g. `bg-slate-900/80`).
- **Gradients**: Combine `bg-gradient-to-*`, `from-*`, and `to-*`.
